name: How do I know if my drawings meet California building codes?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if my drawings meet California building codes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Drawings should reference specific code sections, include compliance tables for exits, fire ratings, ceiling heights, and openings, and carry professional stamps where required.
